anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no component with value or part 'CH330'. The Connections sheet only lists USB connectors, diodes, resistors and capacitors, but no USB-UART bridge ICs.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires two otter_CH330 USB-UART bridges in the Connections section for programming/debug.
anomalies.impact: The USB programming/debug interfaces are non-functional because the USB-UART bridge ICs are absent from the design.

anomalies.observed: NAVC HSE1 pins 1 and 3 connect only to C108/C31/R28 and are not connected to NAVC2 PH0/PH1 (pins 5/6). FCC HSE3 pins 1 and 3 connect to FCC2 PE6 (pin 5) and PE7 (pin 37), while FCC2 PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13) connect to C60 and VREF+_FCC respectively.
anomalies.expected: HSE crystals should connect to the MCU HSE oscillator pins: NAVC2 PH0/PH1 (pins 5/6) and FCC2 PH0/PH1 (pins 12/13).

evidence.quote: HSE crystal (both MCUs) | FCC / NAVC | ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3

anomalies.impact: Both MCUs lack a working external 25 MHz clock. They may fail to start or run from the internal oscillator, breaking timing-dependent flight-control functions.

anomalies.observed: The VDD pins of both MCUs are in individual unconnected nets and are not on the +3V3 or +3.3V rails.
anomalies.expected: VDD pins must be connected to the 3.3V rail per the specification: the LD39200PU33R LDO produces 3V3 for MCUs and sensors.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V rail: An LD39200PU33R LDO, fed from the 5 V rail, produces 3V3 for "MCUs and Sensors"

anomalies.impact: The MCUs receive no core power and will not operate, rendering the flight control board completely non-functional.

parsed.summary: The design files contain several serious deviations: the required CH330 USB-UART bridges are missing, the HSE crystals are miswired or disconnected from both MCUs, and the MCU VDD pins are left unconnected to the 3.3V rail. These would prevent the board from powering up and operating as specified.
